evidenceBoundary.direct: Source message String reference and Int32 bits are copied into concrete QuestData fields; local-record path saves previous state bits and writes new source bits.
evidenceBoundary.exact: Actual constructor identity, ordinary field/underlying ABI, on-disk TypeInfo usage definition and bounded owned block byte/register flow.
conditional: Blocks are reached with valid compatible message in RDI and a valid normal caller frame.

Constructed block needs normally returning opaque type-context and barrier calls, a compatible nonnull QuestData constructor receiver, and ordinary returning Win64 callees preserving watched registers/storage.
Local-record block needs the loaded caller-local reference to be valid compatible nonnull QuestData. Its producing dictionary implementation/type resolution remains outside the claim.
The on-disk TypeInfo lane is not evidence of live resolution or successful object allocation.
unresolved: Complete handler entry/return route, _CheckQuestAsset internals and Assets selection.
String-sharing dictionary lookup/insertion identity and mutation, successful allocation, live message execution/state changes.
Meaning or validity of arbitrary message Int32 bits as enum values, source association/order/callback effects.
